theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V C Y : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → InjOn ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → IsCompact C → C ⊆ V → MeasurableSet Y → Y ⊆ C → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → (∀ y ∈ Y, f (ψ y) = F y) → (∀ y ∈ Y, G (ψ y) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (G (ψ y)) (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e) → Measurable G → ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in ψ '' Y ∩ {x | G x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' Y ∩ {x | G x ≠ 0} ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ x in ψ '' Y, ‖G x‖ₑ * φ x ∂μHE[n + 1]
